title: fathom architecture
description: The architecture scorecard: five dimensions, the arithmetic that combines them, the trend over revisions and the delta since the reviewer's own last review. The headless form of `fathom architecture`, for CI and dashboards (ADR-006 §9.5). Owner: `reco-al1`.

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: OK
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: A scorecard was derived or read, and printed. A refused dimension, or a score below `scorecard.alert_below`, is still OK: `fathom check` owns pass and fail.

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: USAGE
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: A flag or its argument is wrong — a `--revision` prefix that matches no scored revision, or matches two.

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: NOT_A_REPOSITORY
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: The path is not a git repository, so there is no spine to score.

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: STORE_CORRUPT
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: The store failed its integrity check; a score read out of it would be a guess.

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: INDEX_DEGRADED
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: No index, no graph revision, or the named revision has no graph. The message names the fix (`fathom analyze`): scoring nothing as 0 would be a false claim.

contract.description: The model contract, not a verb wrapper: the same id the exported artefact and `fathom check` read. A consumer promises to ignore unknown keys.

headline.description: One line, identical to the headline `fathom architecture --json` prints in the text form. The two surfaces are rendered from the same struct.

model.description: The model id. A row written by another model is refused by comparison, not reconciled: `--refresh` re-derives it.

revision.description: The graph revision's root tree, abbreviated to 7 — what a human writes on a whiteboard. The full id rides as `revision_full`.

episode.description: The episode the revision's commit belongs to, or `null`: graph revisions outrank episodes, so the relation is displayed and never assumed.

score.description: `null` when the scorecard refused: a refusal is printed as a refusal, never as 0.

alert.description: `scorecard.alert_below`, reported and never exited on: `fathom check` owns pass/fail.

total.description: The sum of the terms, in hundredths of a point.

checked_sum.description: The sum this card was checked against before publication — `Scorecard::of` refuses a total that is not the sum of its terms.

denominator.description: The weight sum over the measured dimensions — the renormalisation, printed rather than hidden.

built_utc.description: Microseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC: the instant this card was derived, stored with it so a re-derived row is distinguishable from the one it replaced.

question.description: What the dimension asks, spelled out — the same sentence `fathom architecture --explain` prints.

source.description: Which earlier lane the raw number comes from, ticket included. A number with no named source is a number nobody can argue with.

reason.description: Empty when measured; the sentence that says why not otherwise. A refusal is a finding.

curve.description: The two integers (or the count and the knee) the dimension divided. `null` when the dimension was not measured — never a 0 dressed up as a share.

formula.description: The arithmetic as a string, e.g. `2 / 16 = 0.125`. Recompute it and you get the printed badness.

health.description: 1 - badness, rounded to 6 dp, and nothing else: the arithmetic of the score is five lines and is documented in docs/concepts/scorecard.md.

origin.description: `default` or `fathom.toml`: who set this weight, so a movement can be attributed to a tuning as well as to the code.

points.description: The contribution, in hundredths of a point. The sum of the five `points` is the total, exactly: integers, not float addition.

points_shown.description: The same integer rendered to two decimals, so `jq` addition of these strings equals the printed score.

ceiling.description: The points this dimension would score at perfect health, in hundredths.

complete.description: False when a caveat rode up from the lane that measured it — a coverage figure below its bar. Publishable only when every measured term is complete or disclaimed.

previous.description: The newest stored revision before `scorecard` — the score's own step, without flags changing what 'previous' means. Same shape as `scorecard`, or null when the index holds one scored revision.

since_last_review.description: The delta since the reviewer's own last review, anchored on the revision that review ended at: `basis` names which rung of the ladder was affordable and what it cost. Null when nobody has recorded a review here.

trend.description: One point per scored revision, newest first, folded from the stored rows, thinned to `scorecard.trend_cap` with the oldest and newest ends always kept. Null when nothing is stored.

untouched.description: True when every knob is the built-in default — the honest answer to 'is this repo playing by the published scale or by its own?'

notices.description: What a reader of the payload must know that no column carries: refused dimensions, a thinned trend, foreign rows, an unreliable review anchor.

since_recorded.description: What `since your last review` meant on the day this revision was scored, as the row recorded it: the anchor's rung, the reviewer's state and actor, the revision-count span and the two scores. Kept because review state can be cleared and an episode can be re-segmented out from under an anchor: this is the one place the past meaning of the delta survives. Null when the row was written with no anchor.
